These elections coincided with five referendum questions, including a [[2024 Maine Question 5|referendum to change the state flag]], as well as the [[2024 United States presidential election in Maine|presidential election]], a [[United States Senate|U.S. Senate]] [[2024 United States Senate election in Maine|election]], and various other state, county and local elections.
